description: This file implements degradation-related functions for the Cell_SPM class, including models for SEI growth, surface cracking, lithium plating, and stress calculations based on various scientific models.

classes.name: Cell_SPM
classes.description: A class modeling the single particle model with degradation effects in battery simulations.

methods.name: SEI
methods.description: Calculates the degradation effects of the SEI layer growth based on multiple models, outputs current density and volume fraction decrease.

methods.name: CS
methods.description: Calculates the effects of surface cracking due to fatigue, including crack surface increase and diffusion constant decrease.

methods.name: LiPlating
methods.description: Simulates lithium plating current density based on overpotential and temperature-dependent parameters.

methods.name: getDaiStress
methods.description: Calculates radial, tangential, and hydrostatic stresses in particles based on Dai et al. model.

methods.name: updateDaiStress
methods.description: Updates stored Dai stress values by calling getDaiStress.

methods.name: getLaresgoitiStress
methods.description: Calculates the negative particle stress using Laresgoiti's model based on lithium concentration.
